title: experiment store/3
description: The record the A/B bench keeps in localStorage for a saved comparison (a gravitas.experiment-result/1 of kind comparison, with the store's own schema number `v` beside format and formatVersion): an id, a name, the scenario, the two runs by label with their samples, the unit each metric was sampled in, and the saved comparison and reliability check where there are any. Version 3 withdrew the two drifts earlier versions recorded wrongly. js/experiments/store.js migrate() reads version 1 (the runs as runA and runB, no units block) and version 2, and a record with no `v` as version 1; the schema states the current form. A record from a newer version is refused by reason code (`from-a-newer-version`). FORMATS.md lists it.
